description: List the Feed API schedule templates for a feedType (required), with limit/offset paging; use a template ID with ebay_create_feed_schedule. Schedules exist only for LMS_ORDER_REPORT, which requires sell.fulfillment.

feedType.description: Feed type; schedules exist only for LMS_ORDER_REPORT

offset.description: Zero-based number of results to skip (default 0)

name: ebay_get_feed_schedule_templates
